title: Vuln-lifecycle central vocabulary (C02) — the single source for status/verdict/id-format enums
description: Fixes gap M7: today the lifecycle vocabulary is inlined at rollup.mjs:302-405 + ledger.mjs:3-5 with no central enum. This file is that canon; rollup.mjs/ledger.mjs should import from it (self-scan S8 asserts no drift). Extend HERE, not at the assignment sites.

lifecycleStatus.description: Per-finding presence + resolution state. Presence (born/persisting) and resolution states as assigned in rollup.mjs:302-405.

evidenceTier.description: Verified-cleaned tier from ledger.mjs:3-5. 'weak' is NEVER counted cleaned (recorded as unconfirmed).

residualVerdict.description: Defence-in-depth outcome. NOTE (eval D-EXPIRE/D-PROBE): 'inexploitable' requires a live DAST/BOLA probe (not static prose) and, like 'contained', MUST carry expires+recheckTrigger. Client renders never emit the literal word 'inexploitable' — use 'accepted+contained (recheck YYYY-MM)'. 'undetermined' (D-UNMEASURED) means NO axis was read — it is the absence of an assessment, not a weak one, and is never counted as a defence outcome; client renders say 'defences not assessed'.

axisState.description: Per-defence-axis state. Only 'blocks' counts toward the containment quorum. 'n/a' MUST carry a rationale (skill-lint NA discipline).

bugPlatform.description: Surface the finding lives on. Extends SURFACE_OF_TOOL (build-security-data.mjs:61-66) with image-os/runtime/config.

bugVisibleTo.description: Disclosure visibility. 'embargoed' findings are REDACTED from client-facing renders (eval D-EMBARGO).

primaryIdFormat.description: The identity rule. A finding's primaryId is EITHER a public advisory OR an internal CWX id. The id space encodes provenance (bugIsFoundational is DERIVED from it, not stored — removes the gaming lever).

internalCwx.note: CWX = CommitWork eXploit (NOT MITRE CWE, which is name-blocked — 1564 CWE- occurrences already flow as weaknessClass). Zero-padded 6-wide; overflow ladder digits->hex->base36. MATCHER MUST BE CASE-SENSITIVE AND ANCHORED: a case-insensitive 'cwx' match false-positives on 228 lowercase 'cwx-xxxx' fragments inside GHSA advisory codes (e.g. GHSA-cwx-xvwj-...).

weaknessClass.description: MITRE CWE class(es) the finding is an instance of — the RETAINED, separate field. Public findings get it from NVD/trivy CweIDs[]/retire cwe[]; CWX findings get it from the ruleId->CWE map (C23). Format ^CWE-[0-9]{1,5}$. Used under the MITRE CWE Terms of Use (attribution required — see licensingAndAttribution).

foundationalDerivation.description: bugIsFoundational is DERIVED, never stored: primaryId ^CWX- => true (self-found); ^CVE-|^GHSA- => false (inherited). A CWX that later maps to a CVE flips to false but cwxRef preserves 'we found it first'.
